title: "Billboard Hot 100"

execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}
#| cache: true
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```
```{r}
song_summary <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  group_by(artist, track, date.entered) |>
  summarize(
    first_rank = first(rank),
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_best_week = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    total_weeks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

top10 <- song_summary |>
  filter(best_rank <= 10)

fastest <- top10 |>
  filter(best_rank == 1) |>
  slice_min(first_best_week, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

slowest <- top10 |>
  filter(best_rank == 1) |>
  slice_max(first_best_week, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

longest <- top10 |>
  slice_max(total_weeks, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

notable <- bind_rows(fastest, slowest, longest) |>
  mutate(song = paste(artist, "-", track)) |>
  select(artist, track, date.entered, song) |>
  distinct()

top10_ranks <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  semi_join(top10, by = c("artist", "track", "date.entered")) |>
  left_join(notable, by = c("artist", "track", "date.entered"))

ggplot(
  top10_ranks,
  aes(x = week, y = rank, group = interaction(artist, track, date.entered))
) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(top10_ranks, is.na(song)),
    color = "gray70",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(top10_ranks, !is.na(song)),
    aes(color = song),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(x = "Week on chart", y = "Rank", color = "Notable songs")
```
